headlines.title: 'Nothing has gotten better': Focus group shares affordability concerns as US debt tops $40 trillion
headlines.description: NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur join Meet the Press NOW as the U.S. national debt tops a record-breaking $40 trillion. Ravi Agrawal, editor in chief of Foreign Policy, discusses President Trump's plans for an "Economic D-Day" for Iran. An NBC News focus group produced by Syracuse University and the research firms Engagious and Sago finds that affordability remains the top issue for voters ahead of November's midterm elections.

headlines.title: Democrat Aisha Wahab wins the special election for Eric Swalwell’s former California district
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Wahab, a state senator, defeated fellow Democrat Melissa Hernandez in the race to serve out the rest of Swalwell’s term.

headlines.title: USS Lincoln heads home after extended deployment to the Middle East
headlines.description: Service members and their families had complained about deteriorating morale on the ship as its mission was extended to support the Iran war.

headlines.title: Neutrogena addresses backlash over its past brand deal with Hayden Panettiere
headlines.description: Panettiere said this year that the company had severed ties with her over a “morals clause” after she spoke about her postpartum depression.

headlines.title: Surrogate who had baby in Texas against parents’ wishes denies ‘political theater’ accusation
headlines.description: McKenna West, the surrogate in the center of a multi-state legal battle over a baby who was born with a rare heart condition, sought to “set the record straight.”

headlines.title: Hacker targets ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ in apparent leak
headlines.description: The gaming world has been rattled by what appears to be a major leak of the highly anticipated “Grand Theft Auto VI,” with the alleged hacker warning other publishers that “no one is safe” from similar breaches.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Navy discusses renaming aircraft carrier after Trump instead of heroic Black sailor
headlines.description: The USS Doris Miller would be the first aircraft carrier named after a Black and an enlisted sailor. The decision to name the carrier after Miller was made during Trump’s first term.

headlines.title: Trump and former fixer Michael Cohen bury the hatchet
headlines.description: The president and his former fixer put their contentious past behind them and reunited on Cohen’s radio show after years of legal feuds and name calling.

headlines.description: The incentive is open to members of a Georgia battalion who re-up for two to six years. The hotly anticipated game comes out in November.
